device.title: Audio devices
settings.title: Settings
settings.tray: Keep running in the tray when closed
settings.tray_tip: Closing the window hides it to the system tray (next to the clock) and the filter keeps working. Use "Quit" in the tray menu to exit.
settings.autostart_tip: Opens hidden in the tray every time you sign in to Windows.
settings.autostart_failed: Could not change the Windows startup setting
settings.resume: Turn the filter back on at launch
settings.resume_tip: If the filter was on when the app closed (or the PC shut down), it starts again automatically with the same devices.
tray.hidden: Tapis is still running in the tray. Right-click the icon and choose "Quit" to exit.
eq.hint: Drag a point to change frequency and gain, scroll over it to change Q (width). Double-click the graph to add a band. Tick several presets to combine them.
eq.lock_tip: Lock the preset choice and every band so nothing changes by accident. Click again to unlock.
eq.locked_hint: Presets and all bands are locked. Click "Presets locked" to unlock.
eq.band_lock_tip: Lock this band so it cannot be edited or removed. Locked bands are kept when you change presets.
dyn.comp_tip: Evens out loud and quiet speech: levels above the threshold are reduced by the ratio, then the makeup gain lifts everything back up.
dyn.limiter_tip: The output never goes above the ceiling, so loud sounds do not distort. Adds no delay.
settings.control_note: Other programs and AI assistants can control Tapis while it runs, for example "tapisctl status", "tapisctl start" or "tapisctl set strength=1.3" in a terminal. AI apps that support MCP (such as Claude Desktop) can use it as a tool: copy the MCP setting and add it to the app's MCP configuration. Only programs on this PC, signed in as you, can connect.
settings.control_copied: MCP setting copied to the clipboard.
app.subtitle: Real-time audio noise processing
eq.all_tip: Click to turn all bands on or off.
eq.band_on_tip: Turn this band on or off.
about.title: About
about.body: Realtime microphone noise filter for Windows. AI model: {model}. {copyright}. Source code under the MIT License; the AI model is for non-commercial use.
contrib.privacy_link: What is sent and how to delete it: privacy policy
vocal.tip: Keeps the harmonics, breath and natural decay of speech and singing so the voice does not sound dry. Removes a little less noise. With the AI model it always keeps 10 % of the original sound.
mix.tip: Blend of filtered and original sound. 100 % = filtered only. Around 70–85 % brings back warmth and harmonics while keeping most of the noise reduction.
strength.tip: How much noise is removed. 1.00 = normal. If your voice sounds dry or thin, try 0.6–0.8.
mic.title: Microphone problem
mic.err.denied:
Windows did not let Tapis use the {side}.

Open Settings › Privacy & security › Microphone and turn on all three switches: “Microphone access”, “Let apps access your microphone” and, further down the page, “Let desktop apps access your microphone”. Tapis is a desktop app, so it is not in the list of apps on that page; only the last switch counts for it. Then click Start again.

Are all three already on? Then something else blocks the microphone: an antivirus with microphone protection (Kaspersky, ESET, Bitdefender, Norton…), the laptop maker's privacy app (Lenovo Vantage, HP, Dell…), or a policy on a school or office PC. Allow Tapis there.
mic.err.silent:
The {side} is on, but it only sends silence.

Check the microphone mute key on the keyboard (often F4 or F8, with a small light), the laptop maker's app (Lenovo Vantage, HP, Dell…), and Settings › Privacy & security › Microphone › “Let desktop apps access your microphone”. If you use a headset, check its mute switch.
mic.err.in_use:
Another program is using the {side} exclusively (often a meeting, recording or game app). Close that program and click Start again.

To stop this for good: Sound settings › More sound settings › Recording › your microphone › Properties › Advanced, and turn off “Allow applications to take exclusive control of this device”.
mic.err.exclusive_off: Exclusive mode is switched off for the {side} in Windows. Turn off “Exclusive mode” in Tapis, or allow exclusive control in the device's properties (Sound settings › More sound settings › Advanced).
mic.err.not_found: The {side} is not available. It may be unplugged, switched off or disabled in Sound settings. Plug it in, press the refresh button next to the device list and choose it again.
mic.err.format: The {side} refused the audio format. Turn off “Exclusive mode”, or set the device to 48000 Hz in Sound settings › the device › Format.
mic.err.busy: Windows audio could not open the {side} right now. Wait a moment and try again. If it keeps happening, unplug and re-plug the device or restart the PC.
mic.err.unknown: The audio devices could not be opened. Check that the {side} works in another app, then try again. The technical details below help when reporting a bug.
mic.short.silent: The {side} only sends silence (muted or blocked?)
mic.short.in_use: The {side} is in use by another program
mic.short.exclusive_off: Exclusive mode is not allowed for the {side}
mic.short.busy: Windows audio could not open the {side}
mic.short.unknown: Could not open the audio devices
mic.exclusive_fallback: Exclusive mode did not work with this device, so the filter runs in shared mode.
contrib.reason.mic_silent: the microphone only sent silence (muted or blocked)
contrib.err.offline: No internet connection, or the sample server could not be reached.
contrib.err.timeout: The connection was too slow. Try again.
contrib.err.tls: The secure connection was refused. A school or office network, or an antivirus that checks HTTPS, may be blocking it. Try another network, for example a phone hotspot.
contrib.err.blocked: This network blocked the connection to the sample server (a school or office web filter?). Try another network, for example a phone hotspot.
contrib.err.rate_limited: Too many samples in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
contrib.err.rejected: The server did not accept the sample
contrib.err.server: The sample server has a problem right now. Try again later.
